abstract: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for every self-power of the smooth minimal K3 model of $Y^2=X^3+6aUX+2U(2U-a^3)$, where $U=D_5(s)-2$. Its generic Picard number is 14 and its transcendental endomorphism field is $\mathbf Q(\sqrt5)$. An explicit degree-120 curve-square map constructs the quartic-CM Weil classes of a primitive abelian eightfold. A second quotient realizes the determinant variation on a fixed surface dominated by CM elliptic curves. Invariant theory and a simultaneous CM character argument establish HC for arbitrary mixed products of finitely many sources and associated K3s. A quotient of the curve square times a CM elliptic curve carries a K3 pencil with a fiberwise symplectic order-five action. Relative divisors and compact Leray weights provide curve support for the rank-32 spin summand; a polarization adjoint gives an algebraic retraction to an abelian sixteenfold. Generically its fourth power is isogenous to the full even-Clifford Kuga--Satake variety. Relative comparison, smaller Clifford factors and a separate elliptic-source endpoint prove algebraicity of the specified canonical KS correspondence for every finite parameter. Allowing two independent source parameters produces ordered-pair sixteenfolds with actual algebraic retractions. At every tuple of non-CM sources, the Hodge-group classification shows that these provide every required highest-weight edge, including at special parameters. Rational descent and ordinary mixed HC then prove the rational generalized Hodge conjecture for all products of the associated K3s, paired sixteenfolds and actual KS varieties. For two jointly very general K3 members, a rank-32 transcendental tensor constituent is supported on a divisor. Twelve exact CPU certificates check the algebraic and representation inputs. Classical domination mechanisms are credited. Generalized support for CM-source tuples is outside our independent result; general rational HC remains open.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
change_summary: Extend the mixed-source theorem to CM parameters. Construct moving spin support through a symplectic K3 pencil, actual abelian retractions and the generic rational KS comparison. Extend the specified canonical KS algebraicity to all finite parameters using relative comparison, smaller Clifford factors and a separate elliptic-source endpoint. Vary the two source parameters independently to construct ordered-pair sixteenfolds, enlarge ordinary mixed HC at all smooth pairs, and prove generalized HC for all non-CM K3--spin tuples by the actual special Hodge-group classification, rational highest-weight descent and cycle support. An explicit deck projector controls rank jumps; quotient graphs retain every needed edge. Incorporate the three minor v1 review clarifications, six additional exact certificates, and precise credit for classical domination and the overlapping low-rank endpoint theorem. Clarify the CM generalized-support scope relative to classical CM domination and the existing all-CM preprint claim.
title: Curve quotients, Kuga--Satake correspondences and generalized Hodge support in a moving Dickson K3 family
